records.name: Maiden Burst
records.effect: Creates a heart-shaped energy barrier/explosion around the user.

records.name: Fake Blast
records.effect: Teleports behind the opponent and releases a damaging burst that can inflict paralysis.

records.name: Energy Dome
records.effect: Creates a dome-shaped Ki barrier around the user that can nullify incoming Ki attacks.

records.name: Super Explosive Wave
records.effect: Generates a large defensive explosion that launches nearby opponents.

notes: All four records are Future Warrior-accessible in the reviewed evidence. Maiden Burst is learned from Pan training; Fake Blast from Cooler training; Energy Dome from Future Gohan training; and the Evasive Super Explosive Wave from Piccolo training. The identically named Future Gohan/Orange Piccolo Super Skill is a separate Energy Wave skill and is not conflated with this Evasive.
